full_judgment: 77. This Division in Chairman Bangladesh Textile Mills vs Nasir Ahmed Chowdhury (22 BLD (AD) 199 = 7 BLC (AD) 144) stated in the context of both promissory estoppel and legitimate expectation, that "In this conflict of doctrine the demands of fairness are proving the stronger. But these demands cannot be pressed to the point where they obstruct change of policy which a government should be at liberty to make within its discretionary power or legitimate practice".
